help:
214-SKIBIDITOILET - Brainrot Quiz & Video SMTP Extension
214-Tests your Gen Alpha / internet slang knowledge. Are you built different?
214-
214-Subcommands:
214-  SKIBIDITOILET HELP
214-    Prints this help message. You clearly needed it.
214-
214-  SKIBIDITOILET START <LEVEL>
214-    Starts a quiz. Available levels:
214-      BABYGRONK      - 15 questions, easy mode. For the NPC crowd.
214-      SKIBIDITOILET  - 30 questions, balanced. Mid-tier rizz required.
214-      OHIOFINALBOSS  - 60 questions, maximum aura drain. Only sigma males apply.
214-
214-  SKIBIDITOILET ANSWER <your answer>
214-    For multiple choice: reply with A, B, C, or D.
214-    For fill-in-the-blank: type your answer.
214-
214-  SKIBIDITOILET QUIT
214-    Forfeits the current quiz. Your aura will not recover from this.
214-
214-  SKIBIDITOILET WATCHSKIBIDITOILET [params...]
214-    Streams Skibidi Toilet Episode 1 as ASCII Art over SMTP.
214-    Your terminal must support ANSI escape codes.
214-
214-    Parameters (space-separated, all optional):
214-      WIDTH=<n>       Output width in characters    (default: 120, max: 450)
214-      FPS=<n>         Playback frame rate           (default: 10.0, max: 20)
214-      CONTRAST=<f>    Contrast multiplier           (default: 1.2)
214-      BRIGHTNESS=<f>  Brightness offset             (default: 0.0)
214-      GAMMA=<f>       Gamma correction              (default: 1.0)
214-      ASPECT=<f>      Character height/width ratio  (default: 2.0)
214-      INVERT          Invert brightness mapping
214-
214-    Example:
214-      SKIBIDITOILET WATCHSKIBIDITOILET WIDTH=160 FPS=12 CONTRAST=1.5
214-
214-    WARNING: Color mode is not supported (monochrome only).
214-    WARNING: Once playback starts, it CANNOT be stopped except by
214-             disconnecting. You have been warned. No cap.
214-    WARNING: Maximum 1 concurrent viewer globally.
214-    WARNING: Each line is prefixed with '250-' per SMTP multi-line
214-             response format. This is normal. Embrace the jank.
214-
214-Notes:
214-  - Quiz runs inline in the SMTP session. No MAIL transaction needed.
214-  - Commands are case-insensitive. Your excuses are not.
214 214 End of HELP. Skibidi dop dop yes yes.
